title: The unique derived comparison with exactly the original theorem's ordinary, termwise and K-flat normalization, with the derived comparison returned fi
statement:
Let h : Z ⟶ W and k : W ⟶ V be morphisms of schemes. Let R_V, R_W and R_Z be sheaves of commutative rings on the small pro-etale sites of V, W and Z. Let c_k : k^{-1}R_V ≅ R_W and c_h : h^{-1}R_W ≅ R_Z be coefficient isomorphisms, and let c_hk : (h ≫ k)^{-1}R_V ≅ R_Z satisfy c_hk = proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients h k R_V R_W R_Z c_k c_h, where the composite coefficient identification is the canonical inverse-image composition followed by c_k and c_h. Then there exists exactly one isomorphism of derived module-pullback functors

proEtaleRingDerivedPullback (h ≫ k) R_V R_Z c_hk ≅ proEtaleRingDerivedPullback k R_V R_W c_k ⋙ proEtaleRingDerivedPullback h R_W R_Z c_h

with the following property. There are adjunctions adj_k, adj_h and adj_hk between each of the three module pullback functors and its corresponding direct-image functor, and each adjunction has the canonical tensor-unit normalization: for every module, pro-etale test object and section, its unit is proEtaleRingModuleUnitSection. There is an isomorphism d from the composite direct image (first along h, then along k) to the direct image along h ≫ k such that, for every R_Z-module N, every U in the pro-etale site of V and every section m of the composite direct image of N over U, (d.hom.app N).val.app (op U) m is N.val.map ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp h k).hom.app U).op m. There is an isomorphism a from the pullback functor for h ≫ k to the composite of the two module pullback functors whose conjugate under the three adjunctions is d. There is an isomorphism b between the induced cochain-complex functor for h ≫ k and the composite induced cochain-complex functor, and for every cochain complex K and degree n its component satisfies (b.hom.app K).f n = a.hom.app (K.X n). Finally, for every K whose terms are flat on the site and which is acyclic under tensoring with every acyclic complex, the pullback along k is again acyclic under tensoring with every acyclic complex and has flat terms on W, and the canonical derived-pullback factor maps satisfy

(proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackFactors (h ≫ k) R_V R_Z c_hk).hom.app K ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (b.hom.app K)
= comparison.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)
  ≫ (proEtaleRingDerivedPullback h R_W R_Z c_h).map ((proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackFactors k R_V R_W c_k).hom.app K)
  ≫ (proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackFactors h R_W R_Z c_h).hom.app (((proEtaleRingModulePullback k R_V R_W c_k).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K).

The uniqueness is of comparison; the predicate only asserts existence of the displayed normalized witnesses. No properness, boundedness, or flatness assumption on h or k is made.

proof.text: Apply the existing proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackComposition theorem in Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtaleDerivedPullbackComposition to obtain the three normalized adjunctions, sectionwise direct-image compositor d, its ordinary conjugate a, its termwise compositor b, and a compatible derived isomorphism c. Reorder the existential witnesses to give existence in the requested characterization. This uses the general existence theorem underlying lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition, rather than its later canonical-selection alias.

For any second witness, the unit normalization identifies each of its adjunctions with the first: apply Adjunction.ext, natural-transformation extensionality, sheaf-module extensionality, and equality of the displayed unit formulas on every section. The displayed sectionwise formula likewise identifies d. Injectivity of conjugateIsoEquiv then identifies a. HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext and the degree formula identify the forward natural transformations of b.

For a flat-term K-flat complex, substitute equality of b into the two representative equations. Their left sides coincide. Cancel the two factorization-isomorphism maps on the right to identify the components of the derived comparisons on that complex.

To extend this component equality, apply Localization.natTrans_ext for the derived localization Q. Resolve each arbitrary complex K by a quasi-isomorphism p:P→K from a K-flat complex with flat terms using lem-pc-kflat-resolution. Convert its monoidal tensor-flatness to IsFlatOnSite with the existing siteSheafTensorRightIso from lem-weil-pbc-independent-sheaf-tensor-colimits. Q(p) is an isomorphism; naturality of both comparisons and cancellation of its functorial image reduce equality at Q(K) to the equality already established at Q(P). Finally Iso.ext upgrades equality of forward natural transformations to equality of isomorphisms.

theorem proEtaleCanonicalPullbackComposition_existsUnique
    {V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ W) (k : W ⟶ V)
    (R_V : Sheaf (ProEt.topology V) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (R_W : Sheaf (ProEt.topology W) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (R_Z : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Z) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c_k : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage k CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R_V ≅ R_W)
    (c_h : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage h CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R_W ≅ R_Z)
    (c_hk : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage (h ≫ k) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R_V ≅ R_Z)
    (hc_hk : c_hk = proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients h k R_V R_W R_Z c_k c_h) :
    ∃! comparison : proEtaleRingDerivedPullback (h ≫ k) R_V R_Z c_hk ≅
        proEtaleRingDerivedPullback k R_V R_W c_k ⋙
          proEtaleRingDerivedPullback h R_W R_Z c_h,
    ∃ (adj_k : proEtaleRingModulePullback k R_V R_W c_k ⊣
          proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage k R_V R_W c_k)
      (adj_h : proEtaleRingModulePullback h R_W R_Z c_h ⊣
          proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage h R_W R_Z c_h)
      (adj_hk : proEtaleRingModulePullback (h ≫ k) R_V R_Z c_hk ⊣
          proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage (h ≫ k) R_V R_Z c_hk),
      proEtaleRingModuleAdjunctionNormalized k R_V R_W c_k adj_k ∧
      proEtaleRingModuleAdjunctionNormalized h R_W R_Z c_h adj_h ∧
      proEtaleRingModuleAdjunctionNormalized (h ≫ k) R_V R_Z c_hk adj_hk ∧
      ∃ (d : proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage h R_W R_Z c_h ⋙
            proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage k R_V R_W c_k ≅
              proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage (h ≫ k) R_V R_Z c_hk),
        (∀ (N : proEtaleRingModules Z R_Z) (U : V.ProEt)
            (m : ((proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage h R_W R_Z c_h ⋙
              proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage k R_V R_W c_k).obj N).val.obj (Opposite.op U)),
          (d.hom.app N).val.app (Opposite.op U) m =
            N.val.map ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp h k).hom.app U).op m) ∧
        ∃ (a : proEtaleRingModulePullback (h ≫ k) R_V R_Z c_hk ≅
              proEtaleRingModulePullback k R_V R_W c_k ⋙
                proEtaleRingModulePullback h R_W R_Z c_h),
          conjugateIsoEquiv (adj_k.comp adj_h) adj_hk a = d ∧
          ∃ (b : (proEtaleRingModulePullback (h ≫ k) R_V R_Z c_hk).mapHomologicalComplex
                (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ≅
              (proEtaleRingModulePullback k R_V R_W c_k).mapHomologicalComplex
                (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
              (proEtaleRingModulePullback h R_W R_Z c_h).mapHomologicalComplex
                (ComplexShape.up ℤ)),
            (∀ (K : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules V R_V) ℤ) (n : ℤ),
              (b.hom.app K).f n = a.hom.app (K.X n)) ∧
              ∀ (K : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules V R_V) ℤ),
                CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat K →
                (∀ n : ℤ,
                  SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite (J := ProEt.topology V) (R := R_V) (K.X n)) →
                CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat
                  (((proEtaleRingModulePullback k R_V R_W c_k).mapHomologicalComplex
                    (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) ∧
                (∀ n : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite (J := ProEt.topology W) (R := R_W)
                  ((((proEtaleRingModulePullback k R_V R_W c_k).mapHomologicalComplex
                    (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K).X n)) ∧
                (proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackFactors (h ≫ k) R_V R_Z c_hk).hom.app K ≫
                    DerivedCategory.Q.map (b.hom.app K) =
                  comparison.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≫
                    (proEtaleRingDerivedPullback h R_W R_Z c_h).map
                      ((proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackFactors k R_V R_W c_k).hom.app K) ≫
                    (proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackFactors h R_W R_Z c_h).hom.app
                      (((proEtaleRingModulePullback k R_V R_W c_k).mapHomologicalComplex
                        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) := by
  sorry

split_report.summary: Repaired the machine-truncated imported statement against the complete Lean declaration, retained its exact ∃! comparison predicate, and added one statement-only supporting node for uniqueness of the normalized module adjunction. The existing general derived pullback composition theorem supplies existence; normalized adjunction uniqueness, sectionwise direct-image extensionality, conjugation injectivity, degreewise cochain extensionality, and K-flat localization supply uniqueness. No hypotheses on the scheme morphisms were added. Maintainer reader (2026-10-27): the new node lem-route-pro-etale-module-adjunction-normalized-unique was dropped as a two-line consequence of the existing Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-ext and sheaf-module extensionality (now step 2); step 1 now cites the nodes whose statements give each witness (canonical unit normalization, sectionwise compositor, conjugation, K-flat preservation, localization) instead of only the parent route theorem.
